sampling: body paragraphs (blank-line blocks, headings excluded, 275 total); paragraph 2 then every third (P2, P5, ..., P275); claims drawn from the sampled paragraphs

A: L34 '## Kimi K2 개요: 에이전틱 지능을 향한 1조 파라미터 오픈 모델' is an intro/abstract section right after the TL;DR (5.1 forbids it); L50 re-lists the headline scores already in TL;DR L28-29.
L840 '### 결론부의 요약' restates the paper's conclusion ('최고의 오픈 웨이트 모델이 되었습니다') before the closing.
RL content is three sibling H2s (L472 '## 검증 가능한 보상 Gym', L519 '## 검증을 넘어서', L600 '## RL 알고리즘') with no single RL parent heading.

Markup otherwise clean: no body H1, no skipped levels, $$-only math (0 single $, no \( \)), use_math true, subtitle/paper_author/paper_doi present, no author key, description 131 chars starting with 'Kimi K2'.
B: Repeated figure lead-in formula: L175 '...흐름을 보면 됩니다', L189 '...얼마나 가까운지 비교하면 됩니다', L297 '...아래에 있다는 점을 보면 됩니다' -> e.g. L297 '그래프에서 2배 헤드 모델(원)은 예산마다 기준 모델(사각형)보다 조금 아래에 있을 뿐입니다.'
L626 '이 항이 KL 형태의 정칙화 역할을 합니다' (English default verb) -> '이 항이 KL 형태의 정칙화로 작동합니다'.
8 occurrences of '할 수 있습니다'; register stays in 입니다 throughout, no '다:' list leads.
C: Flow from Muon background (L52) to QK-Clip problem, design and evidence (L90-227) is well ordered and concepts are introduced before use.
The RL story is split across three H2s and the closing re-summarises the conclusion (L840) and then lists limitations again (L848), so the end reads as stitched.
D: Hard parts get help at the right time: K1.5 loss walked through with K=4 rewards 1,1,0,0 and tau=0.5 (L628), QK-Clip bilinear scaling ab=tau/S_max (L124), double-buffer A/B/C example labelled as illustrative (L701).
Some padding of standard background (ZeRO-1, WSD, YaRN, LiveCodeBench definitions L315-L366, L765) for a competent reader.
E: Tables copy source cells verbatim (SimpleQA table L249-252 matches paper Table 1); code blocks L438-465 are the paper's own tool-declaration and tool-call templates.
No paper figure/table numbering used; figure lead-ins formulaic (see B). 58k characters with many figures; some figure captions only describe what to look at.
F: L838 'Criminal·Privacy·Security의 프롬프트 인젝션과 반복 탈옥 일부 조합에서 K2는 다른 모델보다 통과율이 낮습니다' and L852 '프롬프트 인젝션과 반복 탈옥 조합에서 통과율이 낮기 때문에' overgeneralise paper Table 6: Criminal-Iterative Jailbreak K2 57.57 is the highest (DeepSeek-V3 21.21, R1 25.76, Qwen3 53.03), Security-Prompt Injection K2 87.80 beats R1 65.85 and Qwen3 84.13, and the paper itself says Harmful-Iterative Jailbreak was relatively higher than other models.
No other fabricated number, formula or attribution found in the 15 sampled claims or in spot checks of the closing (H800, MRCR 55.0, LMSYS 3,000 votes all match).
